parsed.scene_description: The image shows an empty room with a blue tiled floor. The room has white walls and a large window on the left side. On the right side, there is a kitchenette with a sink, a stove, and a dishwasher. There are two black bar stools in front of the sink and a whiteboard on the wall. In the center of the room, there are two gray sofas and a wooden coffee table. A clock is hanging on the whiteboard. The floor is made of blue tiles and there are a few other items scattered around the room.
